issue.title: voice.speak delivery trace can leak secret-like failure text
issue.actual_behavior: When payload.telegram_delivery.failure_reason contains secret-like values or local paths, voice.speak returns that raw text in result.delivery_trace.failure_reason and runtime_state.telegram_delivery.last_failure_reason.
issue.expected_behavior: voice.speak should redact payload/env-derived secret-like values and local paths before returning delivery failure diagnostics.
repro_steps: Create a temp builder env file with fake ElevenLabs key and voice id values.
Call voice.speak with telegram_delivery.status=failed and failure_reason containing the fake key and env-file path.
Observe pre-fix result.delivery_trace.failure_reason and runtime_state.telegram_delivery.last_failure_reason include unredacted values.

evidence.before_after_proof: Before: delivery failure reason echoed raw key/path fragments. After: both delivery trace and runtime state carry bounded redacted reason text.

proposed_fix.approach: Sanitize telegram_delivery failure reason with payload-aware redaction before building runtime_state and delivery_trace for voice.speak.
proposed_fix.tests_or_smoke: PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest tests/test_spark_hook.py -q -k 'voice_speak_redacts_telegram_delivery_failure_reason or voice_speak_uses_telegram_compatible_opus_for_telegram_surface'; PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q tests/test_spark_hook.py; PYTHONPATH=src python /private/tmp/.tmp_redaction_after.py

review_claim.duplicate_notes: Searched open PRs/issues on 2026-05-31 for telegram_delivery, failure_reason, and delivery_trace redaction surfaces; no matching open fix was found.
review_claim.risk_notes: Change is limited to delivery-reason redaction plumbing; no provider selection, transcript behavior, Telegram routing, memory authority, or identity boundaries changed.
